summary: __usercall destructor-style teardown: registers a structured exception handler frame, installs the object vtable off_5ADBB8, runs VertexColorPackRGBto16 as color/palette cleanup, frees a heap resource at index v2[1051] when non-null via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and releases child objects through VtableSetFreeChild. Prologue artifacts (v1/v2 seeded from registers, spill slots at a1-16 and a1-4) indicate this is a frame-epilogue wrapper.

local_names.v2: alias of v1 used for field and child access
local_names.a1: frame pointer (ebp); spill slots a1-16 and a1-4 hold prologue bookkeeping

operations.description: Call SEHHandlerInit to register the structured exception handler frame; the frame references code label loc_59C59E as the handler address.
Install vtable: *v1 = &off_5ADBB8, tagging the object as an instance of the off_5ADBB8 vtable.
Store v1 into prologue spill slot at a1-16 and initialize cleanup flag at a1-4 to 0.
Call VertexColorPackRGBto16(v1) for color-space or palette cleanup during teardown.
Guard on v2[1051]: when the resource pointer at that index is non-null, free it; otherwise skip.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(v2[1051]) to deallocate the heap resource.
Set cleanup flag at a1-4 to -1, marking the teardown complete.
Return VtableSetFreeChild(v2) which releases child objects attached to the vtable chain.
